text: When someone is out sick or on leave, their tasks don't wait politely. An admin can open anyone's list and hand the work to someone who's in.
The one thing to remember: use Person to open their list, then move what's due and what's coming.
Jordan is out today. In Person, pick Jordan Pike.
Every tab now shows Jordan's tasks.
This call is overdue. Click Move.
Then Active, for what's due today.
It's for Robin, the practice manager.
Then Future, for what starts while Jordan is away.
For everything coming up, click Re-assign all on this tab. It moves Jordan's tasks, not yours.
When you're done, set Person back to Me.

The most common mistakes: moving only the overdue tasks and forgetting what's coming, and leaving no note, so the new owner has to guess. Remember: use Person to open their list, then move what's due and what's coming.
